items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: The name 'Monk' appears exclusively as the first name of the interviewer, Monk Rowe. There is no mention of Thelonious Monk or any other person named Monk in the transcript.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe, I’m very pleased to have Mike Davis with me for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Welcome, sir.
Good to be with you, Monk. Thanks so much for having me.
Right off the top of the bat, would you define “freelance” as in freelance musician?
